d41: 🕯️ Axel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d41: 🕯️ Axel Lang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Axel — and Axel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

echoSample: d44: "Huh. Let me think about that." "Axel is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
d44: "I keep turning over the last thing Axel said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
d44: "The fire feels smaller without Axel. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
d44: "Axel always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Axel Lang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Axel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Axel Lang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Axel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Axel's gone." Roberto looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Axel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Deborah blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Axel Lang, 41 days. The mantle passes to Deborah Michalski.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Deborah Michalski, 68 — an aquarium keeper. Her hands know different work now: Bloodhound, Lucky Rock, Beast-calm, Trophy Room, Green Whisper.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Axel — and Axel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Roberto, Tomas, Hassan and 5 more speak for Deborah — "Axel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Deborah before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

d93: You knew Emma — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
